changes.comment: Close the gaps consuming projects had been working around. `Button` gains a `danger` variant, an `lg` size that meets the 44px touch target, a `loading` state that keeps its width and its accessible name, and `pressed` for toggles. `Badge` gains the four status kinds, sharing `Callout`'s vocabulary. `Card` gains `tone="subtle"`. A `Label` component ships and `.yl-label` is styled standalone, so the class works where the package's own documentation said it would. `Table` cells take `numeric` for right-aligned tabular figures, and `TableScroll` provides a labelled horizontal scroll region. `Tooltip` supplies `tabIndex` so a non-focusable trigger still opens it. The five overlay hooks that shipped inside the bundle and were exported by neither entry point are now exported from `/client`. An unclassed anchor inside `.yl-root` finally reads `--yl-color-fg-link`, which was defined from the first release and applied to nothing.
